explanation: Oligodendrocytes are the glial cells that produce the myelin sheath for neurons in the central nervous system (CNS), which includes the brain and spinal cord. Schwann cells are the glial cells that produce myelin for neurons in the peripheral nervous system (PNS), which consists of the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord. While Glial cells play an important role in neuronal regeneration, and oligodendrocytes are the specific glial cells responsible for myelination in the (CNS). So A is correct option.
